summary_md:
# #141 - AI-agenter, Grönlandshausse och fabriksbesök hos Husqvarna

**Feed**: montrosepodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts of the Montrose podcast describe a risk-on week: OMXS30 rose almost 3%, lifted by a US–Denmark–Greenland Arctic security deal, falling oil prices, an expected Fed rate hike and lower US 10-year yields. Much of the episode covers a factory visit to Husqvarna, whose turnaround rests on shifting towards less price-sensitive professional customers, and Meta's new Muse AI agent, which they see as driving the move to CPUs and agent-based AI. They also discuss why Avanza and Nordnet sold off on fears about AI agents, which the hosts think is overdone. Overall the tone is positive but hedged with macro and competition risks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 AZA — Avanza | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The hosts think the AI-agent sell-off is overdone. Trust, the brand and regulation protect the customer relationship.

#### Reasoning

The hosts argue the market lumps everyone together once a story takes hold, as it did with the earlier drop after Anthropic's launch. People will not hand their life savings to a Facebook bot in the short or medium term. The risk is that AI agents take over the customer interface and turn brokers into pure infrastructure.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI agents take over the customer interface and brokers become pure execution infrastructure
- if agents drive price competition on brokerage fees

> *"Avanza har inte ens rådgivning. Det är därför förstod jag inte alls. Det var helt fel av marknaden."*

---

### 🟡 SAVE — Nordnet | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fell with Avanza on AI-disruption fears. The hosts think the reaction is partly overdone because trust matters so much.

#### Reasoning

Same case as Avanza: finance is a trust business with deposit guarantees and investor protection, so a quick move to AI agents is unlikely. The market is pricing a future scenario, not today's situation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI agents take over the customer relationship
- if new AI-built front ends take users away from the platform

> *"Överskatta inte teknologin när det kommer till att folk ska ta ut familjesilvret och bara skeppa över allting till en Facebook-bot."*

---

### 🟠 HUSQ-B — Husqvarna | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Share price looks depressed after years of weakness. New CEO is shifting the mix towards the professional/B2B segment, which is less price-sensitive.

#### Reasoning

After the factory visit the hosts were positive about the company's history and automation, but they were cautious on the investment case. Chinese competition is tough in the consumer segment (60% of sales), and the move towards professional customers is not yet proven ('vi får se om det bär frukt').

#### Sell Triggers

- if the shift towards professional customers fails
- if Chinese price pressure keeps squeezing the consumer segment

> *"Så just denna förskjutning mot mer B2B, Ja, vi får se om det bär frukt. Låt oss hoppas det."*

---

### 🟠 META — Meta Platforms | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The Muse AI agent is spreading widely thanks to Meta's 3 billion users. Stock up over 32% in a month.

#### Reasoning

The hosts see Muse as a big step in making AI agents mainstream, helped by Meta's unmatched reach, and it has given Meta a clear place in the AI race. They question Meta's privacy record and say Muse may not end up the leader in a year.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Muse loses users to Apple or other competitors
- if privacy concerns slow adoption

> *"Meta har nu stigit över 32% senaste månaden."*

---

### 🟠 SKA-B — Skanska | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Winning many data centre orders in the US as the data centre boom spreads.

#### Reasoning

The hosts note that the data centre boom benefits Skanska's US business. They warn that if AI spending slows, together with high energy prices, the US economy could be hit twice over.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data centre investment slows
- if the US economy weakens

> *"Nu ser vi Skanska tar ganska många datacenterordrar i USA."*

---
